title: Condition-controlled iteration: the while loop
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Waiting room
objectives: know how to write a while loop and what makes it stop repeating
understand how a validation loop keeps asking until the value typed in is acceptable
know how a sentinel value ends a loop when the amount of data is not known in advance
starter: A program sets count = 5, then a while loop runs for as long as count > 0, and the only line inside the loop prints count. Describe what happens when this program runs, and write down the one line that is missing.

stations.name: A loop with a condition
stations.fact: A loop whose condition never becomes False is an infinite loop, and it will freeze the program.
stations.challenge: What has to change inside a while loop for it ever to stop?

stations.name: Sentinel values
stations.fact: Sentinel means guard: the value stands at the end of the data keeping watch.
stations.challenge: Why must a sentinel be a value the real data can never take?

final.title: Final challenge: for or while?
final.instr: write your answer for each one.
rows: Ask until a valid locker number is typed
Keep guessing until the number is right
Add up a known number of marks
Double the weed until it covers the pond

keyq: How do you decide between a for loop and a while loop before you write a single line of code?
exam: A validation loop reads a number, then repeats for as long as it is outside 1 to 50. When 99 is typed the program reports the same wrong number over and over. State what has been left out of the loop, and where in the loop it belongs.
Write a program that reads lengths of rope in centimetres until 0 is typed, then prints how many lengths were read and their total length.
Write a program that keeps asking for a password until one of at least 8 characters is typed, and then prints Accepted.
